name: Venus API — Production Readiness Test Suite
description: Test suite for validating the Venus API SiLA 2 server. Covers simulation mode, method loading, execution, pause/resume, abort, state queries, error handling, lock controller, WebUI, logging, and script runner. Tests can be run in Simulation mode (no VENUS hardware) or Real mode (requires VENUS Web API).
